newsitem.title: JAPAN: NCB says expects to announce reform plan in April.
newsitem.headline: NCB says expects to announce reform plan in April.

text.p: Nippon Credit Bank Ltd said on Thursday it expects to officially announce its restructuring plan in early April.

Asked whether NCB can come up with a reform plan within the next two weeks at the latest, Tadao Iwaki, senior managing director of NCB, said: "Yes, I think it will be in that direction. From the flow of things at the moment, it will be around that time."
Iwaki also said the bank had to see its final earnings results for the fiscal year to March 31 before officially deciding on its restructuring plan.

Although Iwaki repeatedly declined to elaborate on details of the bank's reform plan, as it has not been officially decided, he did say sales of real estate and the closing of some branches were among the measures which should be considered.
Asked whether the plan will gain the confidence of financial markets, Iwaki said he was sure it would.
A Bank of Japan spokesman said on Thursday that the central bank will take proper measures, while maintaining contacts with the Finance Ministry, regarding NCB's efforts.
